verdicts.reason: A rearranges the design for the banner shape: logo on the left, copy in the middle, and the Reserve a Case button with 'Ships late June' on the right. But the six-line headline is crammed in at a microscopic size, the body copy runs into the legal line, which overlaps it at the bottom, and the copy block is jammed against the logo and button. B is just the original portrait layout shrunk to the middle of the banner, leaving wide dead strips of cream on both sides. Every piece of text, including the headline, is an unreadable speck, and the CTA is a dot, so it fails the brief's rule to rearrange rather than shrink.
